gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-georama: Structural and striking, with spacious gaps at curve ends. Stencilia states the case boldly while Georama, a friendly sans with a bracelet-like c and low capitals, carries the explaining.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-hind-mysuru: Blunt, structural, and built to catch the eye first. What stands out is how Stencilia's wide curve gaps meet Hind Mysuru's lowercase, which presses tight against the ascender height.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi reads with a high mean line and curves that end loose and unclosed. Stencilia supplies the structure, and the text below stays out of the way.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-cuneif: Stencilia cuts spacious gaps into its curve ends for a structural look, while Noto Sans Cuneiform waits below with plump lowercase. Paragraphs in its open-eyed, bead-round letters feel light going down.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-imperi: Striking, structural lettering up top, its curves cut open at the terminals. And if Stencilia shrinks small, its spacious gaps lose their punch beside Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic's pincer-shaped c.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki keeps its exits wide and every e clear. The hand-off is the draw: Stencilia strikes hard with its curve gaps, then the body lets light through every exit.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha stands tall, its lowercase carrying the stature of cast iron capitals and its curves kept wide open. Under Stencilia, paragraphs settle into an approachable rhythm.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-mono: Stencilia leads with structural gaps at its curve ends, then hands off to Noto Sans Mono's sturdy, generously spaced letters. Long text there reads steadily, every word looking large.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-tamil-: Stencilia is all structure, with spacious gaps cut where its curves end. And where it commands attention, Noto Sans Tamil Supplement quietly carries the reading with round, parenthesis-like forms.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Striking, structural lettering with spacious gaps cut into its curves. Stencilia grabs attention up top, while Noto Sans Telugu, with its high-set midline and open-sided counters, does the steady reading below.
